headline: Devon Energy (DVN) Pulls Back Following A Mixed Run, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
summary: Devon Energy (DVN) has drawn fresh attention after recent price moves, with the stock down about 4.2% over the past day and modestly lower over the past week despite a small gain this month. See our latest analysis for Devon Energy. That pullback comes after a mixed run for Devon Energy, with the share price return up 2.25% over 30 days but down 12.77% over 90 days.
